s0101.literal: On renzi day the Baiyuewu clan was enfeoffed as empress.
s0101.idiomatic: On renzi day the Baiyuewu clan was enfeoffed as empress.

s0102.literal: On jiayin day the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Surveillance Commission was re-established.
s0102.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Surveillance Commission was re-established.

s0103.literal: Shandong transport commissioner Alisha and others increased tax notes by forty-one thousand eight hundred ingots; each was granted one brocade robe.
s0103.idiomatic: Shandong transport commissioner Alisha and others increased tax notes by 41,800 ingots; each was granted one brocade robe.

s0104.literal: On bingzi day the moon encroached upon Fang.
s0104.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon encroached upon Fang.

s0105.literal: Households under Tughlugh Buqa and others were granted more than thirty-seven thousand ingots of notes; camel-herding households were granted more than one hundred two thousand ingots.
s0105.idiomatic: Households under Tughlugh Buqa and others were granted more than 37,000 ingots of notes; camel-herding households were granted more than 102,000 ingots.

s0106.literal: Because Huai'an, Jiangling, Mianyang, Yang, Lu, Sui, and Huang suffered drought, Kaifeng and Guide suffered floods, and Long and Shaan suffered locusts, their field rents were all remitted.
s0106.idiomatic: Because Huai'an, Jiangling, Mianyang, Yang, Lu, Sui, and Huang suffered drought, Kaifeng and Guide suffered floods, and Long and Shaan suffered locusts, their field rents were all remitted.

s0107.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen day, seventy-eight sluice dams for lakes and channels in western Zhejiang were established.
s0107.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on gengchen day, 78 sluice dams for lakes and channels in western Zhejiang were established.

s0108.literal: Distilling wine at Karakorum was forbidden.
s0108.idiomatic: Distilling wine at Karakorum was forbidden.

s0109.literal: On yiyou day Venus encroached upon Fang.
s0109.idiomatic: On yiyou day Venus encroached upon Fang.

s0110.literal: On wuzi day twenty prisoners were released.
s0110.idiomatic: On wuzi day 20 prisoners were released.

s0111.literal: On dingyou day Taihu Lake and Dianshan Lake were dredged.
s0111.idiomatic: On dingyou day Taihu Lake and Dianshan Lake were dredged.

s0112.literal: On jihai day notes of one hundred two thousand ingots were granted to the Longfu Palace camel herdsmen; Prince Hede's following was granted one hundred thousand ingots; the King of Yunnan Yesi Temür and his following were granted thirty-eight thousand ingots; Karakorum garrison troops were granted more than one million four hundred thousand ingots and twenty-nine thousand bolts of silks and cloths.
s0112.idiomatic: On jihai day notes of 102,000 ingots were granted to the Longfu Palace camel herdsmen; Prince Hede's following was granted 100,000 ingots; the King of Yunnan Yesi Temür and his following were granted 38,000 ingots; Karakorum garrison troops were granted more than 1,400,000 ingots and 29,000 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0113.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiangling Circuit suffered locusts; grain was issued in relief for both.
s0113.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiangling Circuit suffered locusts; grain was issued in relief for both.

s0114.literal: Twelfth month, on jiyou day, the Zhenchao ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Yuan and Jing; the Piyang ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Chen Prefecture; the Junzhou ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Changde and Li Prefectures.
s0114.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiyou day, the Zhenchao ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Yuan and Jing; the Piyang ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Chen Prefecture; the Junzhou ten-thousand-household office was relocated to garrison Changde and Li Prefectures.

s0115.literal: Prince Yuehunan was granted a silver seal.
s0115.idiomatic: Prince Yuehunan was granted a silver seal.

s0116.literal: On bingyin day an edict ordered that garrison troops in each province be released in rotation after two years of service.
s0116.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict ordered that garrison troops in each province be released in rotation after two years of service.

s0117.literal: The Palace Provision Commission was promoted to senior second rank.
s0117.idiomatic: The Palace Provision Commission was promoted to senior second rank.

s0118.literal: On guiyou day an edict ordered that for property receipts and disbursements in the central secretariat, nothing lacking a voucher or record was to be granted from now on.
s0118.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict ordered that for property receipts and disbursements in the central secretariat, nothing lacking a voucher or record was to be granted from now on.

s0119.literal: Arughun Saghri, retaining the posts of steward of state, director of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and head of the Astronomical Bureau, was made grand councillor.
s0119.idiomatic: Arughun Saghri, retaining the posts of steward of state, director of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and head of the Astronomical Bureau, was made grand councillor.

s0120.literal: Princes Liushi, Tuotuo, and others were granted more than thirteen thousand ingots of notes; the four keshik guard soldiers were granted more than fifty-two thousand ingots; households under wanhu Sare'ughuru were granted forty thousand ingots.
s0120.idiomatic: Princes Liushi, Tuotuo, and others were granted more than 13,000 ingots of notes; the four keshik guard soldiers were granted more than 52,000 ingots; households under wanhu Sare'ughuru were granted 40,000 ingots.

s0121.literal: Huai'an and Yangzhou suffered famine; Yijinai garrison-farm in Gansu also suffered drought; all were relieved with grain.
s0121.idiomatic: Huai'an and Yangzhou suffered famine; Yijinai garrison-farm in Gansu also suffered drought; all were relieved with grain.

s0122.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on bingshen day, the ban on lawless rowdies in the capital was strictly enforced; offenders were tattooed and flogged seventy strokes, then detained.
s0122.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, on bingshen day, the ban on lawless rowdies in the capital was strictly enforced; offenders were tattooed and flogged 70 strokes, then detained.

s0123.literal: On xinchou day an edict ordered that Mongol grand marshal Esen Taghai must not on his own decide capital punishment without an imperial order.
s0123.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered that Mongol grand marshal Esen Taghai must not on his own decide capital punishment without an imperial order.

s0124.literal: It was ordered that Karakorum garrison troops who had borrowed ortoq money need repay only the principal.
s0124.idiomatic: It was ordered that Karakorum garrison troops who had borrowed ortoq money need repay only the principal.

s0125.literal: On guimao day the Huaidong grain-transport canal was restored.
s0125.idiomatic: On guimao day the Huaidong grain-transport canal was restored.

s0126.literal: Prince Tash Temür was granted a gold seal.
s0126.idiomatic: Prince Tash Temür was granted a gold seal.

s0127.literal: Hanlin academician Sengjia was granted five hundred ingots of notes to support his mother.
s0127.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Sengjia was granted 500 ingots of notes to support his mother.

s0128.literal: Prince Muhunan's following was granted more than twelve thousand ingots; the Baluchisi and other followings were granted sixty thousand ingots.
s0128.idiomatic: Prince Muhunan's following was granted more than 12,000 ingots; the Baluchisi and other followings were granted 60,000 ingots.

s0129.literal: Second month, dingwei new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0129.idiomatic: Second month, dingwei new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0130.literal: On yimao day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Mount Tai.
s0130.idiomatic: On yimao day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Mount Tai.

s0131.literal: On bingchen day the empress dowager died; the next day she was enshrined and buried at the preceding imperial tombs.
s0131.idiomatic: On bingchen day the empress dowager died; the next day she was enshrined and buried at the preceding imperial tombs.

s0132.literal: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0132.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0133.literal: On renxu day the Emperor instructed He Rongzu, saying: "Statutes and ordinances are excellent laws; they ought to be fixed early.
s0133.idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor instructed He Rongzu, saying, "Statutes and ordinances are excellent laws; they ought to be fixed early.

s0134.literal: " Rongzu replied: "Your subject has selected three hundred eighty articles; one article may cover three or four matters.
s0134.idiomatic: Rongzu replied, "Your subject has selected 380 articles; one article may cover three or four matters.

s0135.literal: " The Emperor said: "Past and present differ in what is fitting; there is no need slavishly to follow precedent — only take what fits the present.
s0135.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Past and present differ in what is fitting; there is no need slavishly to follow precedent — only take what fits the present.

s0136.literal: " On jiaxu day one hundred thousand shi of grain was issued to relieve famine victims in Hubei; the prohibitions on mountains and marshes were also relaxed.
s0136.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 100,000 shi of grain was issued to relieve famine victims in Hubei; the prohibitions on mountains and marshes were also relaxed.

s0137.literal: Chenghai garrison-farm was abolished and re-established at Haza; agricultural implements and seed were supplied.
s0137.idiomatic: Chenghai garrison-farm was abolished and re-established at Haza; agricultural implements and seed were supplied.

s0138.literal: On yihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0138.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0139.literal: Garrison-farm was established at Taihe Ridge of the Western Capital.
s0139.idiomatic: Garrison-farm was established at Taihe Ridge of the Western Capital.

s0140.literal: Prefectures and counties of Wusa, Wumeng, and other places were established; Huili and Sixichuan prefectures were each split in two, and Weimo Prefecture was established.
s0140.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties of Wusa, Wumeng, and other places were established; Huili and Sixichuan prefectures were each split in two, and Weimo Prefecture was established.

s0141.literal: On bingzi day Li Ting was ordered to drill the soldiers of each guard.
s0141.idiomatic: On bingzi day Li Ting was ordered to drill the soldiers of each guard.

s0142.literal: The Prince of Jin's following was granted forty thousand ingots of notes.
s0142.idiomatic: The Prince of Jin's following was granted 40,000 ingots of notes.

s0143.literal: Third month, on yiwei day, Ningguo and Taiping circuits suffered drought; twenty thousand shi of grain was granted in relief.
s0143.idiomatic: Third month, on yiwei day, Ningguo and Taiping circuits suffered drought; 20,000 shi of grain was granted in relief.

s0144.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingwu new moon: an edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to rectify accumulated abuses.
s0144.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingwu new moon: an edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to rectify accumulated abuses.

s0145.literal: On renzi day Zhu, wife of Sun Yi of Baoying County, Gaoyou Prefecture, gave birth to three sons at one delivery; three years of taxes and corvée were remitted.
s0145.idiomatic: On renzi day Zhu, wife of Sun Yi of Baoying County, Gaoyou Prefecture, gave birth to three sons at one delivery; three years of taxes and corvée were remitted.

s0146.literal: On bingchen day Wutiao River garrison-farm was established.
s0146.idiomatic: On bingchen day Wutiao River garrison-farm was established.

s0147.literal: On dingsi day this year's silk and silver levies at Shangdu and Longxing and the supplemental taxes and field rents at Dadu were remitted.
s0147.idiomatic: On dingsi day this year's silk and silver levies at Shangdu and Longxing and the supplemental taxes and field rents at Dadu were remitted.

s0148.literal: Prince Yemiegan was granted a gold seal with gilding.
s0148.idiomatic: Prince Yemiegan was granted a gold seal with gilding.

s0149.literal: Burma dispatched envoys presenting a white elephant.
s0149.idiomatic: Burma dispatched envoys presenting a white elephant.

s0150.literal: On wuwu day Associate Administrator Zhang Yisun and his younger brother Gui and others were executed at Longxing market.
s0150.idiomatic: On wuwu day associate administrator Zhang Yisun and his younger brother Gui and others were executed at Longxing market.

s0151.literal: Yisun had originally been the adopted son of the wealthy Hu Zhiji of Xingan; later Zhiji had a son of his own and died; Yisun coveted his property and conspired with Gui to murder him, bribing prefecture and county officials to escape punishment.
s0151.idiomatic: Yisun had originally been the adopted son of the wealthy Hu Zhiji of Xingan; later Zhiji had a son of his own and died; Yisun coveted his property and conspired with Gui to murder him, bribing prefecture and county officials to escape punishment.

s0152.literal: His servant Hu Zhong appealed his master's injustice to the authorities; thereupon they were put to death, and the property was all returned to the Hu clan.
s0152.idiomatic: His servant Hu Zhong appealed his master's injustice to the authorities; thereupon they were put to death, and the property was all returned to the Hu clan.

s0153.literal: Central secretariat judicial officer Bulanxi was made grand councillor.
s0153.idiomatic: Central secretariat judicial officer Bulanxi was made grand councillor.

s0154.literal: Imperial nephew Khayishan's princely garrison troops were granted more than twenty-two thousand nine hundred horses.
s0154.idiomatic: Imperial nephew Khayishan's princely garrison troops were granted more than 22,900 horses.

s0155.literal: Fifth month, on guiwei day, Left Chancellor Dala Khan sent envoys saying: "Extravagant spending is unrestrained, and the treasury is gradually empty.
s0155.idiomatic: Fifth month, on guiwei day, left chancellor Dala Khan sent envoys saying, "Extravagant spending is unrestrained, and the treasury is gradually empty.

s0156.literal: " An edict ordered that from now on, for princely households, matters concerning money and grain must not casually be brought to imperial attention.
s0156.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on, for princely households, matters concerning money and grain must not casually be brought to imperial attention.

s0157.literal: The Emperor instructed Academy grand academician Arughun Saghri and others: "The Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Hanlin Academy are places to retire the aged; from now on elevate those elders who complete their terms — do not let them leave at will; if any do leave, punishment will reach you.
s0157.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed academy grand academician Arughun Saghri and others, "The Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Hanlin Academy are places to retire the aged; from now on elevate those elders who complete their terms — do not let them leave at will; if any do leave, punishment will reach you.

s0158.literal: Have the central secretariat informed of this.
s0158.idiomatic: Have the central secretariat informed of this.

s0159.literal: " Fifteen relay stations from Yunnan to Burma were added; each station was supplied with four round tallies and twelve relay vouchers.
s0159.idiomatic: Fifteen relay stations from Yunnan to Burma were added; each station was supplied with four round tallies and 12 relay vouchers.

s0160.literal: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.
s0160.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.

s0161.literal: On xinchou day Venus encroached upon Yuguai, and the moon encroached upon Mao.
s0161.idiomatic: On xinchou day Venus encroached upon Yuguai, and the moon encroached upon Mao.

s0163.literal: Prince Yezhili's following was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes; households under Balin Telisi were granted more than sixty-five thousand ingots.
s0163.idiomatic: Prince Yezhili's following was granted 20,000 ingots of notes; households under Balin Telisi were granted more than 65,000 ingots.

s0164.literal: That month, Tong Prefecture, Pingluan, and Longxing suffered hail; Yangzhou, Nanyang, Shunde, Dongchang, Guide, Jining, Xu, Hao, and Shaobo suffered drought and locusts; Zhending, Baoding, Dadu, Tong and Ji prefectures suffered floods.
s0164.idiomatic: That month, Tong Prefecture, Pingluan, and Longxing suffered hail; Yangzhou, Nanyang, Shunde, Dongchang, Guide, Jining, Xu, Hao, and Shaobo suffered drought and locusts; Zhending, Baoding, Dadu, Tong and Ji prefectures suffered floods.

s0165.literal: Sixth month, on jiyou day an edict enfeoffed Burma's prince Kumalagazhaba as king of Burma and granted him a silver seal, gold and silver vessels, clothing, and other goods.
s0165.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiyou day an edict enfeoffed Burma's prince Kumalagazhaba as king of Burma and granted him a silver seal, gold and silver vessels, clothing, and other goods.

s0166.literal: On bingchen day Grand Tutor Ochicharu was made grand preceptor, Wanze was made grand tutor; both were granted seals.
s0166.idiomatic: On bingchen day grand tutor Ochicharu was made grand preceptor, Wanze was made grand tutor; both were granted seals.

s0167.literal: On dingsi day Venus encroached upon Saturn.
s0167.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus encroached upon Saturn.

s0168.literal: Censor-in-chief Buqumu died; being poor he had no means for burial; five hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0168.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Buqumu died; being poor he had no means for burial; 500 ingots of notes were granted.

s0169.literal: On jiazi day the Tamna general commission was established.
s0169.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Tamna general commission was established.

s0170.literal: An edict ordered that from now on each province must not on its own requisition troops without an imperial order.
s0170.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on each province must not on its own requisition troops without an imperial order.

s0171.literal: The Karakorum grand marshal's office was additionally charged with performing pacification commission duties.
s0171.idiomatic: The Karakorum grand marshal's office was additionally charged with performing pacification commission duties.

s0172.literal: Twenty-two persons from Diaoji'er, Java, Siam, Zhanba, and other states came to court; they were granted clothing and sent away.
s0172.idiomatic: 22 persons from Diaoji'er, Java, Siam, Zhanba, and other states came to court; they were granted clothing and sent away.

s0173.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiaxu new moon: Right Chancellor Wanze requested posthumous title seals and honorific documents for Empress Huirenyusheng.
s0173.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, jiaxu new moon: right chancellor Wanze requested posthumous title seals and honorific documents for Empress Huirenyusheng.

s0174.literal: On yiyou day Asangeye's younger brother Zhesu of Burma and ninety-one others each presented local products at court; an edict ordered the others to remain at Anqing while Zhesu was sent to Shangdu.
s0174.idiomatic: On yiyou day Asangeye's younger brother Zhesu of Burma and 91 others each presented local products at court; an edict ordered the others to remain at Anqing while Zhesu was sent to Shangdu.

s0175.literal: On xinmao day Mars encroached upon Jing.
s0175.idiomatic: On xinmao day Mars encroached upon Jing.

s0176.literal: Wet nurse Lady Han of Ji State was promoted to Lady Shunyu of Yan-Ji State; the Shimot clan was made Lady of Ji State.
s0176.idiomatic: Wet nurse Lady Han of Ji State was promoted to Lady Shunyu of Yan-Ji State; the Shimot clan was made Lady of Ji State.

s0177.literal: Poor people in Hangzhou Route lacked food; ten thousand shi of grain was sold at reduced price.
s0177.idiomatic: Poor people in Hangzhou Route lacked food; 10,000 shi of grain was sold at reduced price.

s0178.literal: Eighth month, guimao new moon: hereditary privilege regulations were revised — sons of officials of senior first rank received senior fifth rank, sons of officials of junior fifth rank received junior ninth rank, with intermediate ranks graded accordingly; Mongols and semu received one rank higher.
s0178.idiomatic: Eighth month, guimao new moon: hereditary privilege regulations were revised — sons of officials of senior first rank received senior fifth rank, sons of officials of junior fifth rank received junior ninth rank, with intermediate ranks graded accordingly; Mongols and semu received one rank higher.

s0179.literal: The Guangdong Salt Tax Intendant Office was established.
s0179.idiomatic: The Guangdong Salt Tax Intendant Office was established.

s0180.literal: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Jing.
s0180.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Jing.

s0181.literal: On gengshen day Asanjiya of Burma and his brothers came to court, confessing the crime of killing their lord;
s0181.idiomatic: On gengshen day Asanjiya of Burma and his brothers came to court, confessing the crime of killing their lord;

s0182.literal: The army campaigning against Burma was disbanded.
s0182.idiomatic: The army campaigning against Burma was disbanded.

s0183.literal: On jiazi day Mercury encroached upon the upper star of Lingtai.
s0183.idiomatic: On jiazi day Mercury encroached upon the upper star of Lingtai.

s0184.literal: Baima County of Daming suffered drought.
s0184.idiomatic: Baima County of Daming suffered drought.

s0185.literal: Intercalary eighth month, on gengchen day Mars encroached upon Yuguai.
s0185.idiomatic: Intercalary eighth month, on gengchen day Mars encroached upon Yuguai.

s0186.literal: On gengzi day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0186.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0187.literal: Central secretariat right vice chancellor He Renjie was made grand councillor.
s0187.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor He Renjie was made grand councillor.

s0188.literal: The Prince of Jin's following was granted seventy thousand shi of grain.
s0188.idiomatic: The Prince of Jin's following was granted 70,000 shi of grain.

s0189.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day Venus encroached upon Dou.
s0189.idiomatic: Ninth month, on wuwu day Venus encroached upon Dou.

s0190.literal: On renxu day the moon encroached upon Yuguai.
s0190.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon encroached upon Yuguai.

s0191.literal: Tamachi troops of Caozhou disputed one hundred twenty qing of land with civilians; an edict ordered that an equal amount of nearby official fields be granted separately.
s0191.idiomatic: Tamachi troops of Caozhou disputed 120 qing of land with civilians; an edict ordered that an equal amount of nearby official fields be granted separately.

s0192.literal: Guangdong Yingde Prefecture darughachi Tughanchar induced more than two thousand households of bandits to submit; Yingde Prefecture was promoted to a route, three counties were established, and Tughanchar was made darughachi and wanhu combined to pacify it.
s0192.idiomatic: Guangdong Yingde Prefecture darughachi Tughanchar induced more than 2,000 households of bandits to submit; Yingde Prefecture was promoted to a route, three counties were established, and Tughanchar was made darughachi and wanhu combined to pacify it.

s0193.literal: On jiazi day Venus encroached upon Dou.
s0193.idiomatic: On jiazi day Venus encroached upon Dou.

s0194.literal: The Central Imperial Household Directorate was changed to the Central Governorship Directorate.
s0194.idiomatic: The Central Imperial Household Directorate was changed to the Central Governorship Directorate.

s0195.literal: Prince Chubo's following was granted more than fifteen thousand four hundred ingots of notes.
s0195.idiomatic: Prince Chubo's following was granted more than 15,400 ingots of notes.

s0196.literal: Famine victims in Jiankang, Changzhou, and Jiangling numbered more than eight hundred forty-nine thousand sixty persons; two hundred twenty-nine thousand three hundred ninety-odd shi of grain was supplied.
s0196.idiomatic: Famine victims in Jiankang, Changzhou, and Jiangling numbered more than 849,060 persons; 229,390-odd shi of grain was supplied.

s0197.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiyou new moon: sacrifices were performed at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0197.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guiyou new moon: sacrifices were performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0198.literal: Eleventh month, renyin new moon: an edict promulgated leniency measures — silk and silver levies and grain taxes of Dade year 5 at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted; nearby prefectures that pastured horses and camels had grain taxes remitted by three-tenths; elsewhere one-tenth was remitted;
s0198.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renyin new moon: an edict promulgated leniency measures — silk and silver levies and grain taxes of Dade year 5 at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted; nearby prefectures that pastured horses and camels had grain taxes remitted by three-tenths; elsewhere one-tenth was remitted;

s0199.literal: Exile sentences were each reduced by half; punishments of beating and below were released;
s0199.idiomatic: Exile sentences were each reduced by half; punishments of beating and below were released;

s0200.literal: For wasteland in north of the Yangzi permitted for cultivation, tax collection had originally been planned for the third year; now the deadline was extended by one year altogether, established as a fixed regulation.
s0200.idiomatic: For wasteland north of the Yangzi permitted for cultivation, tax collection had originally been planned for the third year; now the deadline was extended by one year altogether, established as a fixed regulation.
